printf '%s\n' 'Pinned upstream SDK verification, reviewed single-class source build, release/test APK compilation and lint passed. APKs remain unsigned or signed with an ephemeral synthetic key. No emulator/ARM execution, real ChatGPT login or WAN measurement is implied; no release is published.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      # This branch needs one review screenshot of the real product. Keep it
      # separate from the fixed UI acceptance workloads and their receipts.
      - name: Retain the actual glass navigation integration APK
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) == 'codex/compact-glass-reading' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: glass-navigation-apk-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/integration/app-x86_64-integration.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Prepare a disposable emulator for the glass screenshot
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) == 'codex/compact-glass-reading' }}
        timeout-minutes: 12
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p work/glass-navigation
          exec > >(tee work/glass-navigation/setup.log) 2>&1
          cat > work/glass-navigation/host-resources.sh <<'SH'
          set -u
          date -u
          free -m
          ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,rss,comm --sort=-rss
          cat /proc/self/cgroup
          task_glass_cgroup=$(awk -F: '$1 == "0" {print $3}' /proc/self/cgroup)
          for task_glass_group in "/sys/fs/cgroup${task_glass_cgroup:-/}" /sys/fs/cgroup; do
            for task_glass_counter in memory.current memory.max memory.peak memory.events; do
              task_glass_file="$task_glass_group/$task_glass_counter"
              if [ -r "$task_glass_file" ]; then
                printf '%s\n' "$task_glass_file"
                cat "$task_glass_file"
              fi
            done
          done
          SH
          bash work/glass-navigation/host-resources.sh > work/glass-navigation/resources-before-gradle-stop.txt
          timeout 60 work/profile-build/gradle/gradle-9.8.0/bin/gradle --stop --console=plain 2>&1 | tee work/glass-navigation/gradle-stop.log
          bash work/glass-navigation/host-resources.sh > work/glass-navigation/resources-after-gradle-stop.txt
          test -c /dev/kvm
          sudo chmod a+rw /dev/kvm
          python3 tools/gecko/prepare_android_image.py --component emulator --sdk-root "$ANDROID_HOME" --cache work/glass-navigation/packages --report work/glass-navigation/emulator-package.json
          python3 tools/gecko/prepare_android_image.py --sdk-root "$ANDROID_HOME" --cache work/glass-navigation/packages --report work/glass-navigation/system-image.json
          python3 tools/gecko/prepare_platform_tools.py --sdk-root "$ANDROID_HOME" --cache work/glass-navigation/packages --report work/glass-navigation/platform-tools.json
          export ANDROID_AVD_HOME="$PWD/work/glass-navigation/avd"
          export ANDROID_USER_HOME="$PWD/work/glass-navigation/android-user"
          export ANDROID_EMULATOR_HOME="$PWD/work/glass-navigation/emulator-home"
          mkdir -p "$ANDROID_AVD_HOME" "$ANDROID_USER_HOME" "$ANDROID_EMULATOR_HOME"
          echo no | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager" create avd --force -n glassnavigation -p "$ANDROID_AVD_HOME/glassnavigation.avd" -k 'system-images;android-35;google_apis;x86_64'
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path(os.environ['ANDROID_AVD_HOME']) / 'glassnavigation.avd/config.ini'
          display = {'hw.lcd.width': '1236', 'hw.lcd.height': '2676', 'hw.lcd.density': '480',
                     'hw.initialOrientation': 'Portrait', 'skin.name': '1236x2676',
                     'skin.path': '_no_skin', 'showDeviceFrame': 'no'}
          lines = [line for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.split('=', 1)[0] not in display]
          path.write_text('\n'.join(lines + [key + '=' + value for key, value in display.items()]) + '\n')
          PY
          cat > work/glass-navigation/emulator-supervisor.sh <<'SH'
          set -uo pipefail
          # Use ANGLE's software GLES path for this native screenshot diagnostic.
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd glassnavigation -no-window -no-audio -no-snapshot -no-boot-anim -no-metrics -accel on -port 5554 -gpu swangle -feature -Vulkan -memory 3072 -cores 2 < /dev/null > work/glass-navigation/emulator.log 2>&1 &
          task_glass_pid=$!
          printf '%s\n' "$task_glass_pid" > work/glass-navigation/emulator.pid
          printf 'emulator_pid=%s\n' "$task_glass_pid"
          if wait "$task_glass_pid"; then task_glass_exit=0; else task_glass_exit=$?; fi
          printf '%s\n' "$task_glass_exit" > work/glass-navigation/emulator-exit.txt
          printf 'emulator_exit=%s\n' "$task_glass_exit"
          exit "$task_glass_exit"
          SH
          nohup bash work/glass-navigation/emulator-supervisor.sh < /dev/null > work/glass-navigation/emulator-supervisor.log 2>&1 &
          timeout 5 bash -c 'until [ -s work/glass-navigation/emulator.pid ]; do sleep 0.1; done'
          task_glass_pid=$(cat work/glass-navigation/emulator.pid)
          kill -0 "$task_glass_pid"
          test ! -f work/glass-navigation/emulator-exit.txt
          timeout 60 "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 wait-for-device
          task_glass_booted=false
          for task_glass_attempt in $(seq 1 120); do
            kill -0 "$task_glass_pid"
            test ! -f work/glass-navigation/emulator-exit.txt
            if [ "$(timeout 5 "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 shell getprop sys.boot_completed | tr -d '\r')" = 1 ]; then
              task_glass_booted=true
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          test "$task_glass_booted" = true
      - name: Capture the actual glass navigation screen
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) == 'codex/compact-glass-reading' }}
        timeout-minutes: 6
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          task_glass_pid=$(cat work/glass-navigation/emulator.pid)
          kill -0 "$task_glass_pid"
          test ! -f work/glass-navigation/emulator-exit.txt
          test "$(timeout 5 "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 get-state)" = device
          python3 tools/gecko/capture_glass_navigation.py \
            --root "$PWD" --apk app/build/outputs/apk/integration/app-x86_64-integration.apk \
            --build-work work/profile-build --adb "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" \
            --serial emulator-5554 --aapt2 "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/37.0.0/aapt2" \
            --apksigner "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/37.0.0/apksigner" \
            --out work/glass-navigation 2>&1 | tee work/glass-navigation/capture.log
      - name: Keep screenshot diagnostics and stop the disposable emulator
        if: ${{ always() && (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) == 'codex/compact-glass-reading' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ -f work/glass-navigation/host-resources.sh ]; then
            bash work/glass-navigation/host-resources.sh > work/glass-navigation/resources-after-capture.txt 2>&1 || true
            sudo dmesg --color=never | rg -i 'oom|out of memory|kill' > work/glass-navigation/kernel-oom.txt || true
            sudo dmesg --color=never | rg -i 'segfault|general protection|qemu-system|emulator' > work/glass-navigation/kernel-emulator.txt || true
          fi
          if [ -f work/glass-navigation/emulator.pid ]; then
            timeout 15 "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 logcat -d -s 'PocketUiVisual:I' 'AndroidRuntime:E' '*:S' > work/glass-navigation/final-logcat.txt 2>&1 || true
            timeout 10 "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 emu kill > work/glass-navigation/emulator-stop.txt 2>&1 || true
            task_glass_pid=$(cat work/glass-navigation/emulator.pid)
            if kill -0 "$task_glass_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
              kill "$task_glass_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
            for task_glass_attempt in $(seq 1 20); do
              if [ -f work/glass-navigation/emulator-exit.txt ]; then break; fi
              sleep 0.25
            done
          fi
      - name: Upload glass screenshots and source evidence
        if: ${{ always() && (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) == 'codex/compact-glass-reading' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: glass-navigation-screenshots-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
          path: |
            work/glass-navigation/*.png
            work/glass-navigation/*.mp4
            work/glass-navigation/*.raw
            work/glass-navigation/*.xml
            work/glass-navigation/*.json
            work/glass-navigation/*.log
            work/glass-navigation/*.txt
      - name: Preserve build logs and lint report
